Election Information

GUBERNATORIAL ELECTION DAY IS November 3, 2026


 State Board of Elections Voter Information includes how to register and how and where to vote.

  • Ways to Vote
  • Work on Election Day


Directory of Elected Officials

Each voter in Cook County is represented by officials on many levels, from U.S. Senator and County Commissioner to Park District and School Board Trustee. Because district boundaries vary, you may not have the same representatives as your neighbors across the street. Use the Directory of Elected Officials to find the public officials representing your household. Most officials' contact information and term dates are also listed.

Early Voting

Dates

For the November 3, 2026 Gubernatorial Election, limited Early Voting will begin October 7, 2026 at these six Vote Centers.

Expanded Early Voting begins October 19, 2026 at 56 suburban locations and will continue through November 2, 2026. 

Early Voting locations and hours can be found here. 

 More early voting information

What do you need to Early Vote?

  1. Voters do not need to provide an excuse or reason why they cannot vote on Election Day.
  2. Government-issued photo ID is not required but is helpful if there is a question about the voter's registration, address or signature.  Providing an ID can also speed up the process because we have ID card readers at every check-in station.

You can register to vote at ALL Early Vote sites. NOTE: Any voter who needs to register for the first time or file an address change must present two forms of ID, one of which shows the voter's current address.

You should confirm the above at The Cook County website in case requirements change: https://www.cookcountyclerkil.gov/elections/ways-to-vote/early-voting

 

Voter Assistance in Your Language: https://www.cookcountyclerkil.gov/elections/translated-election-posters%23main-content

 

Vote By Mail. Good News!  Cook County is now offering Permanent Vote By Mail.  For more information on voting by mail, or to download a mail ballot application, go to this link: https://www.cookcountyclerkil.gov/elections/ways-to-vote/vote-by-mail

 

Mail Ballot Drop Box Locations, Dates and Times: https://www.cookcountyclerkil.gov/elections/ways-to-vote/vote-mail/mail-ballot-drop-box-locations


Accessibility and Assistance 

Information on Voting Accessibility and Assistance

How Do I Know I'm Registered?

After processing your registration application, the Clerk's office will mail you a voter identification card with your precinct information and voting districts.  You may also check your voting eligibility with our Your Voter Information search tool. If you have questions about your voting status, please e-mail Voter.Reg@cookcountyil.gov or call (312) 603-0906.


2026 Gubernatorial Election to be held on November 3, 2026. 

Key dates:

  10/6/2026

  Voter registration closes for deputy registrars and local election officials
  10/7/2026  First day of limited early voting at these six locations
  10/18/2026

  Last day to register to vote by online application

  10/19/2026  First day of expanded early voting at these locations
  10/26/2026  Last day to request a mail ballot for military and overseas voters
  10/27/2026  Election voting equipment testing

  10/29/2026

  Last day to request a mail ballot by mail or online

  11/2/2026

  Last day of early voting

  11/3/2026

  Last day mail ballots can be postmarked

  11/3/2026

  Election Day
